name: a11y-html-template-fix-and-validate
description: Applies each fix plan task in server-rendered HTML templates (Django, Jinja2, Rails ERB, Laravel Blade, or static HTML) one task at a time, validating the rendered output (not the template source) with html-validate's accessibility rules and a per-page Playwright axe check before and after, and fixing shared base layouts and partials first.
